Dear Miss Yonge	
There are three aspects of [illegible] [Miss Bonham Carter](/person/1913), not [illegible] is the artist. [I](/person/939) saw it in his studio and concluded it was his own. Of course we can only [engrave](/topic/167) one of the three. I think unquestionably the one looking to the right.[^1]
Please tell me how you like it

Yours ever truly
A. Macmillan


[^1]: Probably portraits of Florence Nightingale that Macmillan was proposing for the title page vignette in [A Book of Golden Deeds](/book/51). The Bonham-Carters were [Florence Nightingale](/person/1086)’s cousins
